article.title: DeepSeek向API開放搜尋、檔案和讀取連結功能
article.summary: DeepSeek公布，開發者可在V4.1-Flash的支援端點使用應用程式原有的搜尋、檔案及讀取連結功能。
highlights: 搜尋可回傳來源，檔案功能支援PDF及其他指定格式。
延伸工具按用量另外收費。
article.why: 品牌團隊可把公開產品資料接入問答流程，並評估來源可追溯性和每次查詢成本。
article.next_step: 用公開型錄和產品頁試做一組問題，逐題核對引用、回答和工具費用。
article.detail: DeepSeek表示，開發者可從支援端點啟用網頁搜尋、檔案輸入及連結讀取，讓模型以外部資料回答。搜尋等延伸工具用量費在模型用量之外計算。品牌試做產品問答時，可先採用一小批已公開資料，核對引述的內容是否符合原頁，以及每條問題觸發多少工具操作。
article.title_en: DeepSeek brings search, files and link reading to its API
article.summary_en: DeepSeek says developers can use search, file input and link reading from its app through supported V4.1-Flash endpoints.
highlights_en: Search can return citations, and file input supports PDFs and other specified formats.
Extended tools incur separate usage fees.
article.why_en: Brand teams can test public product information in a Q&A workflow and assess citations and costs per query.
article.next_step_en: Use a public catalogue and product pages to compare answers, citations and tool costs.
article.detail_en: DeepSeek says developers can enable web search, file input and link reading on supported endpoints so the model can answer with external material. Extended tools incur usage fees in addition to model fees. For product Q&A, start with a small public dataset and check cited material against the original pages and how many tool calls each question triggers.
article.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
